title.en: Unified real-valued periphery joining all nine Mathlib becoming modules

statement.en: BecomingReals unites all nine Mathlib v4.30.0-rc2 periphery modules across slowing-down inertia collapse, exergy fluctuation survival, exchangeable Gibbs variational optimality, operator-norm linear blanket runaway versus hysteresis, and one concrete witness.

laws.en: Iterated AR(1) variance equals metricSlack and tends to SlowingDown.stationaryVariance, while policy-inertia headroom shortfall drives AlignmentReals.inertiaStock below threshold and into RegimeMargin.Drawn.Falls.
Finite probability measures embed as FiniteLaw distributions joining pathwise and expected Flow balance, exergy destruction floors with Markov survival bounds, and integral fluctuation upper bounds.

Under permutation-symmetric energy, normalized Gibbs weights coincide with FreeEnergy.posterior and ExpectedFreeEnergy.softmax, uniquely minimize variational free energy, satisfy Exchangeable marginal symmetry, and share coarse-split blindness.

Under a self-contained L_infinity matrix operator norm (LocalMatrixOpNorm), Euler iterates equal matrix powers, reduce in 1D to SlowingDown.drawnMultiplier, show rate < 1 on Autonomous.emA despite internal-external precision failure, alongside linear FA leakage hysteresis and one cross-module witness.

hypotheses.en: Lean 4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms only (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) through the Mathlib periphery workspace; finite Fintype state/sample spaces, discrete-time Euler steps, and scoped PiLp L_infinity matrix operator norm.

does_not_show.en: Showing real-valued bridges in Mathlib hold under Gaussian independence, exchangeable energies, or linear Euler steps never verifies those assumptions in empirical ML or physical systems (Rule 2).
